items.title: Johnny DeDroit Interview, 1973-03-16
items.q: Bouchon was better than he was supposed to be, you know? But he didn't care. He was selling pies or something.

ctx.x: I used that, Elri. When you're in 40 years you have a lot of turnover. Elri's a good musician. Not great, but good. Bouchon was better than he was supposed to be, you know? But he didn't care. He was selling pies or something. What did he have, a catering business? He had a bar business.
He went in the bar business, he had a bar room. Oh no, he had something.
